_readme: Planning parameters. Tariffs have no machine-readable official source (Kahramaa publishes a 'Productive Farms' category but only through an interactive calculator), so they are required inputs: enter them from your own Kahramaa bill. Structural modelling choices are labelled model_choice and are documented in the README.

electricity_qar_kwh.label: Electricity unit price (Kahramaa 'Productive Farms' tariff, from your bill)

water_qar_m3.label: Water unit price (Kahramaa 'Productive Farms' tariff, from your bill)

access_fraction.unit: share of plot area kept for access/infrastructure
